h2: Villa Maintenance Canggu: Keep Your Property Running Year-Round
intro: Canggu's rapid growth from rice paddies into villa clusters means many properties face plumbing surprises, pool overflow issues and drain back-ups within the first few years. Our Villa Maintenance Canggu service covers scheduled check-ups of pipes, pumps, water heaters and roofs so small problems don't become flooded pump rooms during the wet season. Whether you manage a rental in Berawa or own a family villa in Pererenan, a regular inspection keeps guests comfortable and protects your investment.

sections.h3: Why Canggu Villas Need More Attention Than You'd Think
sections.text: Most villas here went up quickly on former paddy land, which means a high water table pushes septic tanks to capacity faster and drains back up after heavy rain. Loose fittings, poorly sloped floor drains and hidden pipe leaks tend to surface in the first couple of years. In Batu Bolong and Echo Beach, where streets flood easily, we prioritise checking pump-room seals, pool overflow lines and roof gutters before the monsoon hits.

sections.h3: What a Regular Check-Up Actually Covers
sections.text: A standard visit walks through every tap, shower head, water heater element and external drain. We inspect pool pumps for wear, test circulation flow, clear leaf debris from skimmers and verify that overflow pipes discharge away from the garden. For villa managers running multiple units around Berawa, we compile a written owner report with photos so you can track recurring issues across properties without chasing staff.

sections.h3: Getting a Quote: Just Send Photos on WhatsApp
sections.text: No phone calls, no back-and-forth emails. Snap a few clear shots of the affected area—a dripping joint, a murky pool, a flooded pump room—and message us on WhatsApp. Include your neighbourhood (Babakan, Padonan, wherever the villa sits) and whether it's an urgent leak or a scheduled inspection. We'll come back with what needs doing and a price that depends entirely on the job.

sections.h3: Simple Habits That Save You Headaches in Canggu
sections.text: Clear pool skimmers every two days—leaves from surrounding fields decompose fast in humidity and clog pumps within a week. Before October, have gutters flushed and pump-room drainage verified so the first heavy downpour doesn't turn your garden into a lake. If you notice water pooling near the septic tank after rain, flag it early; the high groundwater here means those tanks fill quicker than in drier parts of Bali.

faq.q: How often should I schedule maintenance for my Canggu villa?
faq.a: For rentals with pools, a monthly visit keeps up with leaf load and guest wear; for owner-occupied villas, twice a year plus one pre-rainy-season check is usually enough to catch issues before they escalate.

faq.q: Do you cover smaller areas like Padonan or Babakan?
faq.a: Yes—we work across all of Canggu, from Berawa through Echo Beach to Pererenan, Babakan and Padonan, so distance rarely affects whether we can get to your property.

faq.q: I'm not sure what's wrong with my pool pump—what do I send?
faq.a: Record a short video on WhatsApp showing the noise or unusual behaviour, include the model name if visible, and we'll tell you over chat whether it needs cleaning, new parts or a full replacement before anyone drives out.
